title: Install Counter-balance (CB) Weights and Restart Operator Station
summary: Securely install the counter-balance (CB) weights using the specified screws/torque, ensure side guarding is reinstalled, and restart the operator station so the system can resume operation.
when_to_use: Use when CB weights have been removed and must be reinstalled, and the operator station must be restarted to resume operation.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: performs the physical installation of CB weights and restarts the operator station.
safety_notes: Two people are required for the CB weights procedure (weights are about 20 kg / 44 lb total).
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the counter-balance weights assembly
Tools to install M10 socket head screws and lock washers
Torque wrench capable of ~51 Nm (65 ft-lbs)
Access to operator station controls to restart the operator station

system_preconditions: CB weights assembly location is accessible for holding and screw installation.

visual_references.description: Figure showing the counterbalance weight assembly on the tipper carriage, including four M10 socket head screws and lock washers, and the note about acceptable carriage movement drifting to the lower hard stop.

steps.title: Hold the CB weights in place
steps.purpose: Prevent the CB weights from falling during installation of the fasteners.
steps.instruction: At the tipper carriage counter-balance weights location, hold the CB weights in place with two people.
steps.expected_result: CB weights are held securely in position at the mounting location while the four M10 socket head screws are installed.
steps.healthy_condition: Weights remain stable in the intended mounting position (no uncontrolled drop).
steps.failure_condition: CB weights cannot be held in place during screw installation.

actions.label: Hold CB weights
actions.exact_action: Hold the CB weights in place.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the CB weights cannot be held in place during screw installation.

source_evidence.quote: 1. Hold the CB weights in place and install the four (4) M10 socket head screws with the lock washer. The weights are about 20 kg (44 lb) total.

steps.title: Install four M10 socket head screws with lock washers and tighten to ~51 Nm
steps.purpose: Secure the CB weights to the carriage using the specified fasteners and torque.
steps.instruction: Install the four (4) M10 socket head screws with the lock washers and tighten to approximately ~51 Nm (65 ft-lbs).
steps.expected_result: All four CB weight fasteners are installed with lock washers and tightened to ~51 Nm (65 ft-lbs).
steps.healthy_condition: Torque wrench indicates tightening to ~51 Nm (65 ft-lbs) for each of the four screws; lock washers are present under the screw heads.
steps.failure_condition: Tightening cannot reach the specified ~51 Nm (65 ft-lbs).

actions.label: Install and torque screws
actions.exact_action: install the four (4) M10 socket head screws with the lock washer. Tighten to ~51 Nm (65 ft-lbs).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if tightening cannot reach the specified ~51 Nm (65 ft-lbs).

source_evidence.quote: 1. Hold the CB weights in place and install the four (4) M10 socket head screws with the lock washer... Tighten to ~51 Nm (65 ft-lbs).

steps.title: Observe acceptable carriage movement if the gripper is not mounted
steps.purpose: Confirm the system behaves as expected when the gripper is not yet mounted (weights drift to the lower hard stop).
steps.instruction: After the weights are in place, if the gripper is not yet mounted, observe the carriage movement; it may begin to move and this movement is acceptable because the weights will drift to the lower hard stop.
steps.expected_result: If the gripper is not mounted, carriage movement occurs and the weights drift to the lower hard stop.
steps.healthy_condition: Carriage movement proceeds toward the lower hard stop (no indication of abnormal behavior described in the procedure).
steps.failure_condition: Carriage movement does not drift to the lower hard stop as described.

actions.label: Observe carriage drift
actions.exact_action: the carriage may begin to move. The movement is acceptable as the weights will drift to the lower hard stop.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if carriage movement does not drift to the lower hard stop as described.

source_evidence.quote: 2. Once the weights are in place, if the gripper is not yet mounted, the carriage may begin to move. The movement is acceptable as the weights will drift to the lower hard stop.

steps.title: Reinstall top and/or bottom side guarding if necessary
steps.purpose: Restore guarding to the configuration required for safe operation.
steps.instruction: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side guarding if necessary.
steps.expected_result: Top and/or bottom side guarding panels are reinstalled (as needed) after CB weight installation.
steps.healthy_condition: Side guarding is reinstalled and appears aligned/secure (no misalignment/unsafe condition).
steps.failure_condition: Side guarding cannot be reinstalled or appears misaligned/unsafe after reinstallation.

actions.label: Reinstall side guarding
actions.exact_action: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side guarding, if necessary.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if side guarding cannot be reinstalled or appears misaligned/unsafe after reinstallation.

source_evidence.quote: 3. Reinstall the top and/or bottom side guarding, if necessary.

steps.title: Restart the operator station
steps.purpose: Bring the operator station back to a running state after mechanical work is complete.
steps.instruction: Restart the operator station (manual references “Starting The Operator Station” on page 66).
steps.expected_result: Operator station restarts successfully after CB weight installation and guarding reinstallation.
steps.healthy_condition: Operator station is in a restarted/running state (no restart failure indicated).
steps.failure_condition: Operator station does not restart after completing the installation and guarding steps.

actions.label: Restart operator station
actions.exact_action: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the operator station does not restart after completing the installation and guarding steps, escalate to FORTNA support for the appropriate restart/troubleshooting procedure.

source_evidence.quote: 4. Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

success_criteria: Four CB weights are secured with lock washers and tightened to ~51 Nm (65 ft-lbs).
If the gripper is not yet mounted, carriage movement drifts to the lower hard stop.
Top and/or bottom side guarding is reinstalled as necessary.
healthy_conditions: CB weights are secured with lock washers and tightened to ~51 Nm (65 ft-lbs).
Acceptable carriage movement occurs and drifts to the lower hard stop when the gripper is not mounted.
Side guarding is reinstalled and appears secure/aligned.
failure_conditions: CB weights cannot be held in place during screw installation.
Carriage movement does not drift to the lower hard stop as described.
Side guarding cannot be reinstalled or appears misaligned/unsafe after reinstallation.
Operator station does not restart after completing installation and guarding steps.
escalation_guidance: If the operator station does not restart after completing the installation and guarding steps, escalate to FORTNA support for the appropriate restart/troubleshooting procedure.
